params.prompt: Create a seamless game character WALK CYCLE on the exact solid flat magenta RGB FF00FF background. Preserve the reference creature's exact appearance, turquoise fur, cream chest, gold accents, face and proportions. It is a quadrupedal small fantasy companion facing in the same three-quarter direction as the reference. Locked orthographic camera, no pan or zoom. Entire creature remains centered within the central 50 percent of canvas, huge magenta margin on every side. Animate a believable in-place WALK, four paws alternately lifting, swinging and planting with clear elbow and knee bending, body weight shifting subtly, tail and ears following naturally. Two complete steady walking strides over four seconds, moving on an invisible treadmill: the character's root never translates, turns or changes scale. Same silhouette and contact pose at beginning and end, no anticipation pause. Keep feet baseline fixed, never clip the tail or ears. No shadows, floor, scenery, effects, text or additional objects. Do not merely wobble or translate a still image; articulated limbs must move.

rejected.reason: Full-body spin instead of a fixed-facing walk; excluded from registry.
